Kaitlyn Watkins · Ashland, Oregon

Elections
Can you run?
Running for council
Ashland City Council

You must be at least 18, be registered to vote in Ashland, and live within the city limits when you file.

You are 34 and live in Ashland.

Filing for council

Collect 25 valid signatures from Ashland voters after the City Recorder approves your petition.

Filing opens June 3. New candidates must file by August 18, 2026.

No filing fee.

Incumbents seeking re-election must file by August 11.
